paragraphs.source_en: My thoughts had been occupied with the orange, when Mr. Porcupine called. It was an unexpected pleasure. He said that as it was a Red Letter Day, he had brought some beef to eat with me. Taking out a bamboo-sheaf wrapper from his sleeve, he placed it in the middle of the room. I was very glad to have it, for potatoes and tofu had been the diet my stomach had been persecuted with in the house where I stayed.
